summary: Iteration 4: scroll/rigid-layout fixes and end-to-end wallet money math. Backend: new suite test_iter4_money_math.py passed 11/11 with a fresh user (mobile+DOB). It covered: deposit pending then verified (a second verify is rejected), daily coupon (+₹10, wagering +₹30, a second claim is rejected), withdrawal blocked while wagering is unfinished, 8 parallel bets with the same client_key debit once, 30 parallel ₹50 bets give exactly floor(balance/5000)=18 successes and the balance never goes negative, admin credit/debit (over-balance debit rejected with 400, bad TOTP rejected with 401), settled balance = deposits+bonuses-stakes+1.95x payouts+credits-debits, UPI save with password, withdrawal of ₹300 approved -> processing -> completed (reserved back to 0, total_withdrawals=30000, a second complete is rejected), a rejected withdrawal refunds exactly once, ledger type filters work, the ledger sum equals the wallet balance, and global reconcile shows [] (no discrepancies). Iter3 regression suite: 12/12 after fixing a stale register payload. Frontend (390x844): the viewport meta blocks zoom; html/body have overflow hidden and overscroll none; #app-scroll is the only scroll container; the game page does not scroll at all (scrollHeight 844 = clientHeight, wheel has no effect); the sticky Wallet header stays at top 0 when scrolled; Wallet->Withdraw, Settings->Withdraw and Wallet->Deposit all open at scrollTop 0 with the form visible; the 'Add UPI details' and 'Edit destination' links open /settings?bank=1&section=bank with the bank form open and scrolled into view. Wallet ledger tabs: Withdrawals shows reserve/paid/refund rows (the paid row shows '₹300.00 paid' in neutral color, not as a credit), Adjustments shows admin credit/debit, and running balances are correct. Admin UI add funds: credit updated the balance, an over-balance debit showed an 'Insufficient balance' toast, and Reports -> Reconcile shows 'All wallets match'.

minor.issue: The ledger entry is inserted before the conditional update on wallet reserved ({reserved: {$gte: amount}}). If reserved is ever short, the ledger records the settlement but the wallet reserved stays unchanged, and nothing reports it (reconcile would catch it later). Consider checking modified_count and alerting.
The same TOTP code can be used again within its window (no replay protection). Low risk but worth hardening for a money action.
Does not push a history entry or reject_reason, unlike the verifier reject. The audit trail on the withdrawal doc is incomplete.

issues: On long labels such as 'Withdrawal requested (moved to reserved)', the right amount column wraps: the '−' sign is on its own line above '₹300.00', and 'Bal' / '₹280.00' also split. Add whitespace-nowrap and shrink-0 to the amount column (Wallet.jsx line ~57) and/or shorten the labels.
pt-2 on the shell leaves an 8px strip above the sticky header at scrollTop 0 (visible as a lighter band on Withdraw/Deposit). Consider pt-0.

action_items: Optional: nowrap the ledger amount column on mobile (Wallet.jsx)
Optional: harden reserved_settle (check modified_count), add TOTP replay protection, add history/reason to the admin withdrawal reject
Optional: Settings opens the bank panel only from the initial ?bank=1 param (useState init). Navigating to ?bank=1 while already mounted on /settings will not open it; use an effect on params.
critical_code_review_comments: The ledger_debit dup-key check followed by a compensating $inc on DuplicateKeyError is correct (verified by the concurrency test), but it briefly over-debits during races. Acceptable.
consume_wagering resets wager_required to 0 once complete, so the wagering progress shows 100% and loses its history. Fine for the UX.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest tests/test_iter4_money_math.py -n 0 (pytest.ini adds xdist, so -n 0 is needed). Clear db.rate_events first. Withdrawals may be assigned to another verifier's account; the tests call /api/admin/withdrawals/{id}/reassign until pv1001 owns them. Use page.request.post to register inside Playwright so the cookie is shared with the browser context.
